_about: Example for tools/harness/quiet-services.ps1 from an Alienware m15 R6 (2026-11-23). Copy to probe-out/quiet-services.json and list your own PC's noisy services. Find them: the top-3 list in noisy rows' 'machine load:' lines (probe-out/queue/*.jsonl), then (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process) parent -> service.
_evidence: AWCC.UCSubAgent: busiest other process in ~100 noisy queue jobs, avg 1.7% of the machine, max 17.3%. Killer.exe: in 867 noisy rows, avg 0.3%, max 1.6%. All children of the services below.
_services: DellTechHub hosts AWCC.*, AWPerformance.*, AlienFXSubAgent and the Dell.TechHub.* sub-agents. Killer Network Service runs Killer.exe; Wi-Fi keeps working through the driver.
_apps: Closed only by a manual 'quiet -Apps' (never by the watcher, it would close them every minute). Spotify was in 3 of 13 'noisy machine early' stops.
